scope: Recovery of expected mechanism and PCV family, not precision across every claim or held-out predictive accuracy.

sqlglot.expected: Repeated scope analysis while merging isolated table CTEs; work grows with merge count times outer scope size.

timing.evidence: merge_ctes and _merge_expressions cumulative timing plus source cache invalidation; submitted M*C and M*S products.
timing.limits: Only table count varies; individual structural factors cannot be separated.

drperf.evidence: Timing round identified merge_ctes before first DrPerf round. DrPerf then localized scope collection and attributed work to structural PCVs.
drperf.limits: Final collector has 59% block residual. Preparation added work to enclosing regions; total-state fit is not a blockwise explanation.

sqlglot.comparison: Both recover the main dependency after timing feedback. This pair does not show a discovery-accuracy advantage for DrPerf.

libcst.expected: Cached left-recursive parsing repeatedly copies growing expression prefixes; linear and triangular-size PCVs vary by grammar shape.

timing.evidence: Native parse timings plus grammar.rs cached-left-recursive rules, recursive Box fields and generated Clone; attributes clone mechanism as an inference.
timing.limits: cProfile cannot attribute native functions; lexical and shape features co-vary.

drperf.evidence: Instruction feedback attributes triangular-size work to native DeflatedExpression/Attribute clone and allocation/free.
drperf.limits: Retrospective saved-data train/test split was not evaluator-reserved. Call-chain block residual remains 21%.

libcst.comparison: Same PCV family recovered; DrPerf supplies direct native-function attribution beyond the control profiler.

comfyui.expected: Per-key ancestor/signature reconstruction; total distinct ancestor closure and link/input volume, quadratic for deep families but linear for wide family.

timing.evidence: Matched-size shapes distinguish closure size from link volume; cProfile calls match source-derived ancestry and conversion counts.

drperf.evidence: Instruction attribution and call counts support closure/input/link volume. Deep graph adds quadratic work; shape controls separate node and link contributions.
drperf.limits: Final recursive hashing residual 15%, outer hashing 47%, assembly 14% (rounded); low residual in local helpers is on a few correlated states.

comfyui.comparison: Both recover the expected dependency. DrPerf exposes incomplete fine-grained explanation; no discovery-accuracy gain in this pair.

summary.interpretation: No observed recovery advantage in this development pilot. This is not a full precision/recall score, independent held-out accuracy, or a statistical equivalence finding.
